items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: he just went there because Santana, you know, all that stuff.

ctx.x: I overheard you telling a humorous story about him at the Grammy awards.

Yeah. He thought he was not going to win. And he was downstairs and he was like that going, “I ain’t going to win nothin. All the Cubans are going to win.” And he actually won. And to make it short, and he told me, “And I had to run down five miles to get my Grammy.” They put me in the tenth tier. He walked out very sad out of the hotel and came back like a little kid. And I’m glad, I said, “Pop, I’m glad you won.” Because he was depressed he was not going to win, he just went there because Santana, you know, all…
There seems to be a pretty big surge in popular music with Latin influences.
